head_commit.message:
fix(wp1345 r1): launcher chon tep thuc thi Windows chay duoc tren Python 3.11

_thuc_thi goi thang ham rieng shutil._win_path_needs_curdir (chi co tu 3.12)
nen lane launcher Ubuntu 3.11 do 2 ca r1335_* voi AttributeError. Them lop
_ShutilWin311 va cho _thuc_thi dung no khi Python < 3.12:
- cwd con luon dung truoc PATH (3.11 chen os.curdir khong hoi Windows);
- which cua 3.11 voi lenh CO thu muc khong ap PATHEXT, nen tim ten tran voi
  path '<d>;.' va chi nhan ket qua nam trong d.
Hai dong goc cua _thuc_thi giu nguyen van de mau dot bien r1335_F6_* van khop
dung mot cho (t117). Python 3.12+ khong doi hanh vi.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
